title: Keyboard shortcuts in the library
objective: Add keyboard shortcuts to the library as a pure function in src/web/shortcuts.mjs: export libraryKey(state, event), where state is { ids: [document ids in row order], highlight: index or -1 } and event is { key, target: { tagName } }. It returns { highlight, action } (action null or { type, id }): ArrowDown and j move the highlight down one row (from -1 to 0; it stops at the last row), ArrowUp and k move it up (it stops at 0), Enter opens the highlighted document (type 'open'), s stars it ('star'), a archives it ('archive'), c copies its link ('copy-link'), ? shows the shortcut sheet ({ type: 'help' }, no id). A key that needs a row does nothing with no highlight. Nothing fires while typing: when target.tagName is INPUT, TEXTAREA or SELECT it returns null. The library page lists the shortcuts in a sheet with data-testid="shortcut-help".
acceptance: Up and Down (and j and k) move a highlight between rows and stop at the ends
Enter opens, s stars, a archives and c copies the highlighted row
? shows the sheet, and the library page carries the shortcut sheet
A row key with no highlight does nothing
Nothing fires while typing in a field
plan_summary: A new pure module src/web/shortcuts.mjs and a static sheet in libraryPage.
